user.title: Add a meter
user.description: Create a manually read utility meter. It gets long-term statistics for consumption and cost that you can use in the Energy dashboard and Statistics graph cards.

data_description.price_per: Gas is often billed per kWh using a conversion factor (kWh/m³) printed on the invoice.

error.invalid_price_per: Pricing per kWh is only available for gas meters measuring volume.

add_reading.title: Add a reading
add_reading.description: Latest reading: {latest}. Change the date to add an older reading.

import_readings.title: Import historical readings
import_readings.description:
One reading per line: a date with an optional time, then the value. Examples:

`2025-01-15 08:30, 1234.567`
`2025-02-15;1250,1`
`15.03.2025 1263.9`

Times are in the Home Assistant time zone. A reading with the same date and time as an existing one replaces it.

add_price.title: Set a price
add_price.description:
Current price: {price}.

The price applies from the given date until the next price. Set an earlier date to recalculate past costs. Consumption before the first price uses the first price.

add_reading.name: Add reading

value.name: Value
value.description: The value shown on the meter.

import_readings.name: Import readings
import_readings.description: Imports many readings at once, one per line as date[ time], value.

update_reading.description: Changes the value or time of an existing reading.

timestamp.name: Timestamp
timestamp.description: Date and time of the reading to change, to the minute.

timestamp.name: Timestamp

set_price.name: Set price
set_price.description: Sets the price from a given date. A price with the same date is replaced.

price.name: Price
price.description: Price per meter unit, or per kWh for meters priced per kWh. Defaults to the previous price.

factor.name: Conversion factor
factor.description: kWh per meter unit, only for meters priced per kWh. Defaults to the previous factor.

valid_from.name: Valid from
valid_from.description: When the price starts to apply. Defaults to now.

valid_from.name: Valid from
valid_from.description: Start date of the price to delete, to the minute.

get_readings.name: Get readings
get_readings.description: Returns all stored readings and prices of a meter.

rebuild_statistics.name: Rebuild statistics
rebuild_statistics.description: Recreates the long-term consumption and cost statistics of a meter from its stored readings and prices.
